title: Offline Support & Persistence
description: Implement offline support, cache persistence, and sync strategies for React Query applications.
longDescription: This module covers offline-first strategies with React Query including cache persistence to localStorage/IndexedDB, handling network interruptions, background sync, online/offline detection, and integrating with service workers for progressive web apps.
whatYouLearn: Persist React Query cache to localStorage and IndexedDB
Handle network interruptions gracefully with retry logic
Detect online/offline status and adjust query behavior
Implement background sync for offline mutations
